description_en: Queries the configuration history of a specified resource. Cloud Config records every configuration and relationship change for a resource in a configuration history. Recording starts after you enable the Cloud Config service. By default, the history is retained for 10 years
description_zh: 查询指定资源的配置变更历史。配置审计记录资源的每一次配置变更和资源关系变更，并整理为配置变更历史。您开通配置审计服务后，配置审计开始记录资源的配置变更和资源关系变更历史，并默认保存10年
kebab_example: aliyun config get-resource-configuration-timeline --resource-id new-bucket --start-time 1623211156000 --end-time 1625821156000 --max-results 10 --resource-type ACS::OSS::Bucket --biz-region cn-hangzhou --next-token IWBjqMYSy0is7zSMGu160000 --api-version 2020-09-07 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetResourceConfigurationTimeline

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the resource.

For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/169620.html
parameters.help_zh:
资源ID。

关于如何获取资源ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/169620.html
parameters.name: resource_id

parameters.help_en: The start timestamp of the time range to query. The value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds. If you do not specify this parameter, the query starts from 30 days before the current time
parameters.help_zh: 开始时间戳。默认查询发起调用前30天的时间。单位：毫秒
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end timestamp of the time range to query. The value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds. If you do not specify this parameter, the current time is used
parameters.help_zh: 结束时间戳。默认查询发起调用时的时间。单位：毫秒
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of entries to return for a single request. Valid values: 1 to 100
parameters.help_zh: 单次请求返回结果的最大条数。取值范围：1~100
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en:
The resource type.

For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/169620.html
parameters.help_zh:
资源类型。

关于如何获取类型，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/169620.html
parameters.name: resource_type

parameters.help_en: The pagination token that is used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results. If the response of the current request is truncated, you can use this token to retrieve the next page of results
parameters.help_zh: 当请求的返回结果被截断时，您可以使用`NextToken`再次发起请求，获取从当前截断位置之后的内容
parameters.name: next_token
